name: lsc-tig-awards grantee_names
compiled_by: MV2 of Munim, Inc., with AI agents working in his name
description: Grantee names in LSC's Technology Initiative Grant (TIG) lists, 2014-2025, that tig_grantees.py counts as another name's organization. Names that differ only by a leading 'The' or a trailing 'Inc.' need no entry. Each organization goes by the name LSC printed in its latest round. Mergers between two grantees are not followed.

fields.state: two-letter code, as in the TIG lists
fields.printed: the name as LSC printed it, without a leading 'The' or a trailing 'Inc.'
fields.organization: the organization's name as LSC printed it in its latest round
fields.kind: spelling: the same name written differently; short_form: a shorter name for the organization in one list; renamed: the organization announced a new name
fields.years: rounds in which LSC printed this name
fields.source: for a rename, the organization's own page that states it; otherwise null
